Maya (Product): FYI leadership wants a trimmed scope for the tenant-pricing pilot. Need alignment across runtime/infra/security for launch criteria.
Ethan (Eng-runtime): confirm the must-have list so we can estimate effort.
Maya (Product): must-haves: 1) deterministic per-req billing metadata, 2) fallback policy for cost spikes (tenant-configurable), 3) flags for regulated tenants to disable fallback. Nice-to-have: predictive batching.
Hana (Eng-infra): infra needs a billing-metadata store and an API to reserve burst capacity. Estimate: 1 week for proto, 3 weeks for production-safe implementation.
Ruth (Security): for regulated tenants we require BYOK support and signed audit entries for billing actions. Incident response plan must include KMS key rotation impact.
Liam (SRE): monitoring: token_cost_per_min per-tenant, reserve_slot_exhausted alert. Chaos plan: simulate 2x sudden qps for pilot tenants.
Jas (ProdOps): runbook draft: what user sees on throttle (429 with json reason), escalation path, contact lists. I'll produce first pass by Wed.
Ethan (Eng-runtime): runtime work: - attach billing tags to router requests - implement fallback hook to quantized model - emit metric billing_tokens and fallback_count. Need infra reserve API.
Hana (Eng-infra): API: POST /reserve_burst {tenant_id, region, slots, ttl}. Must be idempotent and RBAC-protected. We'll prototype for 5 tenants.
Maya (Product): launch gates proposal: feature-flagged rollout, security signoff, infra API in staging, runbook, pilot tenant acceptance tests.
Ruth (Security): I'll review audit schema within 48h after we get sample events. Add requirement: encrypted payloads for billing metadata.
Liam (SRE): acceptance tests: p95 latency under pilot < 200ms, errors < 1%, fallback quality regression test.
Maya (Product): timeline ask: pilot in 4 weeks if infra can deliver reserve API in 1 week. Otherwise push to 6 weeks.
Hana (Eng-infra): agree. I'll aim for API proto in 5 working days; will surface risks asap.
Ethan (Eng-runtime): will open a design PR today with telemetry examples.
Jas (ProdOps): will seed runbook and paging roster.
Maya (Product): thanks all. Action items above — I'll schedule a 15m preflight sync next Thursday.
